White Heat

You draw a narrow line toward your enemy with one finger. White fire flashes around their body and leaves flames clinging where it passed.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Knowledge

Target / range / shape: One visible creature within 6 squares

Proposed NPC defense attribute: Agility.

- Weak: 5 fire damage; Burning 1. - Standard: 5 fire damage; Burning 2. - Strong: 7 fire damage; Burning 3.

Duration: Instant

Equipment / acquisition: None.

---

Tier / minimum level: 7 · DP: 8 · Requirements to learn: Flame 3

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: white-heat
